negative_changed_source_csv.note: Negative-test movie uses correct source poses but intentionally false speed labels; NOT deliverable evidence.

energy_accounting.limits: Stage-consistent quadrature does not remove integrator/solver error or qualify real contact, heat or impact.

flight_assessment.criterion: No geometric contacts; total normal force <=1e-8 N; every cube corner >0.1 mm above plane.
flight_assessment.interpretation: A tiny box-proxy gap is not resolved physical flight. Compare step/solver/contact-envelope sensitivity; display edges themselves are approximate. Edge crossing/tumbling is separate from capture.

startup.initial_condition: All bodies and wheels start at rest; no pre-spun state or velocity reset.
